name: Liner Notes
artist: Todd Farrell, Jr. and The Dirty Birds

artist_ref.name: Todd Farrell Jr. and The Dirty Birds

podcast.body: This song, released in 2013, directly addresses the topic of liner notes, which were described as textual information found on records and within CD booklets that began to disappear in the age of streaming. "That's Todd Farrell, Jr. and The Dirty Birds with a 2013 song about liner notes."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
